title: feat(app-shell): the assistant's entry is an outlined Ask AI button at the end of every page's top-right group

repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwhwiMRQSuaJ1wVVcU

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoVZq3vnWX7teQJ8M5nj9ENi)_

Fixes #37858
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：所有用户在每个页面右上角看到带文字的「问 AI」描边按钮（页头、记录页、Home 顶栏），手机上是 44px 图标；没有页头的页面在内容右上角也有这个按钮（从右到左的语言在左上角）。
- 为什么做：问 AI 入口改造专题里的入口按钮这一张，解决用户找不到问 AI 入口、只看到一个很小的透明机器人图标的问题。
- 出错会怎样：本轮之前兜底按钮会盖住报表编辑器右上角的「保存」「放弃」和收件箱的「全部标为已读」并抢走点击；现在这两处把按钮放进自己的页头，浏览器实测无遮挡。最坏仍是页头很窄时只剩图标，或今后新加的无页头页面在同一角放了自己的按钮；直接撤回这次改动即可恢复原来的机器人图标。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

The assistant's one standing entry (`AssistantTopBarButton`) is now an outlined button with a chat-bubble icon and the words 「问 AI」 / "Ask AI", replacing the 32 px transparent robot named only by its tooltip. Card items, as written on the card:

1. **Button.** `variant="outline" size="sm"`, `h-8`, chat-bubble icon plus the words; pressed style and the amber plan-pending dot kept. The words come from the existing `home.askAI` string (see Acceptance notes: no new key, so no locale pack changes). Mobile is the icon alone at `size-11`.
2. **Placement.** Last in the page's button group (comments, help, Ask AI), so it ends the console page header's row and the record page's navigation row; after help in the app bar (Home and the phone's bar).
3. **Width.** The console page header measures its own width (the same ResizeObserver plus after-render pass its fold already uses) and hides the words first: before its title is cut and, on a page that offers the folded actions, before those actions fold. The words come back once the cluster's lost width fits again, after any fold has opened, so the states cannot flip-flop. Decided by measured content, never a breakpoint. It reaches the group through one new optional slot prop, `assistantIconOnly`.
4. **Routes with no shell header.** `ShellAssistantFallback`, built like `ShellSidebarExpandFallback`: the scope counts the button groups actually drawn under it, and where none is, the same button sits over the content's empty top end corner (`end-2`: top-right, top-left in a right-to-left language) (never on a phone, never with the group turned off, never without AI). Counting drawn groups rather than routes means a page that draws a header through its children is counted correctly. The routes whose page module draws none of the shell headers today (static reading of the route table and each page module at the base commit): `search`, `component/:ns/:name/*`, `inbox` and `inbox/:tab`, `system/marketplace/:packageId`, `reports/new`, `create-app`, `edit-app/:name`, `design/dashboard/:name`, and the not-found route. The report builder's host and the inbox page keep their own controls in that corner, so they draw the group at the end of their own top bar through the slot (`ReportBuilder` takes an optional `headerEnd`, drawn after Save), which also counts it for the fallback. The marketplace package's error-state Back button is sized to its words (`self-start`), as on the loaded page.
5. **Home.** Home's 「Ask AI」 now opens the drawer through `useAskAiEntry`, the entry hook whose no-target arm is the button's own toggle; it still asks the `ask` agent, as it did.
6. **Accessibility.** With its words shown, the words are the accessible name (no `aria-label`); icon only, `aria-label` carries the same words. The marker's words stay the button's description and are kept out of its name. On a Mac the tooltip shows ⌘⇧I and the button declares `aria-keyshortcuts="Meta+Shift+I"`; elsewhere no shortcut is shown or declared (with the words shown and no shortcut to add, there is no tooltip at all).
7. **The objectstack#34827 pin** stays green; see Acceptance notes for the note to objectstack#37860.
8. Apps cannot rename the button: the words are the platform's string, no app input reads them. Visibility rules unchanged (AI surface gate).

## Tests

New pins:
- `AssistantTopBarButton.askAi-37858.test.tsx`: both faces and their names (zh 「问 AI」, en "Ask AI"), no `aria-label` on the text face, icon-only `aria-label`, phone 44 px, pressed style and toggle, link face without a drawer host, marker as description not name, Mac `aria-keyshortcuts` plus ⌘⇧I tooltip, no shortcut elsewhere, every built-in pack carries the words.
- `ShellPageActions.askAi-37858.test.tsx`: group order ending in Ask AI; icon-only through the slot; corner fallback drawn on a group-less route, gone beside a group, absent on a phone, with the group off and without AI; the header's words-first collapse against a width model (words go before the fold, fold opens before the words return, no flip-flop, a no-fold page keeps the words while only its description is cut, no layout keeps the words).
- `HomePage.askAiEntry-37858.test.tsx`: Home's button goes through the entry, on the ask agent, navigating nowhere.
- `ReportBuilderHost.askAiEntry-37858.test.tsx` (round 1): inside the shell there is no corner fallback and exactly one Ask AI, in the builder header after Discard and Save; a bare mount ends with Save.
- `InboxPage-36741.test.tsx`, two cases added (round 1): the header row ends with unread-only, mark-all-read, divider, shell group; no divider outside the shell.

Edited: the objectstack#34827 pin (transition halves), and the two layout harnesses that mounted a bare button beside a header-less page (objectstack#34608, objectstack#26470) now drive the layout's own corner entry; the three edited dock harnesses pay the chat body's grid load at collection, as `check:test-source-alias` prescribes.

Ablation: the header's answer forced to "words shown" turns the three collapse cases red (3 failed / 6 passed), restored from the commit. Round 1: the host's `headerEnd` disabled on disk turns the new report-builder pin red (1 failed / 1 passed), restored.

## Acceptance notes

- **No new key; `Clause-②: no`.** The card asked for a new `topbar.askAi` key reusing `home.askAI`'s translations. Adding it in the eleven packs made `overlap-check` answer exit 1 against objectstack#37676 (it shares those packs). The conflicting hunk is objectstack#37676 against current main, not these lines, but the gate counts any conflict on a file the branch changed. The dispatch allows reusing an existing key, so the button reads `home.askAI` itself: the eleven packs are untouched, and the one entry has one string, which Home's button (now the same entry) already carries.
- **Record page "before ✕".** Since objectstack#36557 ✕ is the navigation row's first control, at its left. The group sits at the row's right end, so Ask AI, now the group's last button, is the row's top-right control. The record view itself is unchanged. The record row does not measure: it has no page actions to push out, and its stepper's view name truncates first. The widest words (ar, 179 px) take 147 px more than the icon. That squeeze is not measured in a browser.
- **For objectstack#37860 (card item 7).** C3 lands first. The objectstack#34827 pin now holds two halves: the drawer title still equals `topbar.aiAssistant` in every pack, and the standing entry reads `home.askAI` beside it. So until C4 the drawer is titled 「AI 助手」 while the button says 「问 AI」. C4 rewrites that pin to "drawer title = conversation title, 「新会话」 before the first send".
- **ui ADR-0057 amendment A3** calls the entry "the top-bar robot". It is not edited here (governed); the wording line is the landing seat's after merge.
- **Not touched, still "AI Assistant" with the robot.** The record pane and record drawer bars' own assistant buttons (`record-pane-open-assistant`, in the list's record drawer and in the record drawer stack) are outside this card's file surface. Carrier: objectstack#37860 or the seat.
- **File surface.** One file outside the claim's list: `shellPageActionsSlot.ts`, one optional prop. It is the header-to-group channel, and a header must not import the group. Two existing layout harnesses were also edited (objectstack#34608, objectstack#26470), as described under Tests.

The inbox detail was opened from the activity tab's first row (detail header present in both locales). During a lazy route's load it shows until the page's header mounts, which is the expand fallback's behaviour too.
- **App bar (Home, organization pages).** It does not measure; it has room for the words at desktop widths. On a phone the button is always the icon.
